limitations: Six physical sources remain separate. Counts refer to source row observations and source-local candidate id/import_id groups; they do not establish unique imports, jobs, resources, customers or charges. No physical source is deduplicated.

Full-record versions retain excluded payload changes and exact numeric tokens. No latest row is elected. Alternate fractional/exponent spellings remain separate typed versions; object-key order and JSON whitespace do not. Raw-line and stream byte comparisons remain separate.

Pair comparisons use a declared same-role strict-string comparison domain. Matching raw-line, full-record or role multisets establish representation agreement only; they do not establish an authoritative namespace mapping, transformation lineage, native identity bridge or permission to union sources.
Same-row tenant/cluster-tenant and project/cluster-project agreement describes literal modeled-column consistency. It does not establish native resource ownership or a validated parent relationship.

Timestamp summaries use fixed syntax and exact fractional timezone-aware ordering. Date-only, naive, absent and unsupported values remain unverified for ordering. Compatible times and reversed times are diagnostics, not effective dates, current state, successful operations or historical ownership.

Field presence is checked over every source row, including absent observations. The approved field catalog began with sampled schemas plus explicit census fields. Unknown top-level field identities and values are omitted; only the number of additional fields is exported after validating their all-row partitions.

Status and flag categories report only explicitly allowed literal spellings or fixed type states. They do not establish business success or failure. Unknown category values are omitted; known literal spellings are observed category values, not identity or customer labels.

Names, emails, region values, URLs, payloads, query or connection values, financial amounts and arbitrary text are neither exported nor fetched. No monetary sum, company/customer classification, Hong Kong attribution or incident impact is established.

Native import baselines are contextual metadata only and are not joined or re-counted here. Authoritative derived-source and ancillary-job namespace mappings remain unestablished in the reviewed evidence; this does not rule out future corroboration.
